kind: One full-size pilot of 24,000 updates, one seed: the lifted loop with weight decay on synapses only, against the lifted loop as piloted.
why: decay_synapses_only_with_data.json screens on the test bed whether a stack learns better when its read gains, grains and offsets by age and its cells' rests are left out of weight decay. The released looped stack (fsp-loop) shows how far those controls moved and which way decay pushes them: its read gains settled at -1.3 to -3.2 (in units of the race's charge scale, flatter races than at the start), with decay pulling them back toward the sharper start at 0; its cells' rests sank from 0.5 to about 0.2 spikes, with decay pulling them further toward 0. Whether leaving them alone pays at full size decides whether the next full-length run takes it, and the bed's verdict and this pilot come in the same night.

arms.fs-loop6-lift-nd: --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --decay-synapses-only at peak rate 6e-4: fs-loop6-lift with decay on synapses only (b2a2117); 34,810,900 parameters, as fs-loop6-lift

base: fs-loop6-lift (1.30073 on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as streams): the same recipe, seed and measure, on the code copy of 97a2772.
runs: sched/bin/full.sh stack fs-loop6-lift-nd --lr 6e-4 --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --decay-synapses-only, on the code copy of b2a2117 (the base's copy predates the option; the commits between add only options that neither run uses), on GPU 0 at priority 37.
measure: As full_size_loop_variants.json: the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams at the trained reach, paired with fs-loop6-lift (experiments/compare_stream_scores.py) and split by context (experiments/gap_by_piece.py, near 240, far 8,192); the controls' sizes at the end (read gains, grains, age offsets, cell rests, knowledge offsets) against fs-loop6-lift's.
reading: One seed: this reading picks a recipe. If fs-loop6-lift-nd is at least 0.003 better than fs-loop6-lift with the paired interval clear of zero, and the bed's screen does not fail with both seeds behind, the next full-length run recorded after both verdicts trains with decay on synapses only. Within 0.002 it is reported, and the bed's own mark decides. Worse by 0.003 or more, the option is not used at full size whatever the bed shows.
seen_before_recording: decay_synapses_only_with_data.json (queued, unscored); the trained controls of fsp-loop as cited; full_size_loop_variants.json's lifted pilot. No run with the option has trained.

seconds_for_24k_updates.note: trained beside test-bed runs and fs-loop6-lift-b1014's end on GPU 0 under MPS

result.reading: fs-loop6-lift-nd is 0.0017 worse than fs-loop6-lift [0.0009, 0.0025], within 0.002: reported, and the bed's own mark decides. The bed's screen failed (decay_synapses_only_with_data.json: a mean lead of 0.0003 after 24,000 updates, one seed ahead), so decay on synapses only is not used at full size. On new contexts the arm is +0.0043.
result.verdict: Decay on synapses only stays off. One seed: a recipe choice.
